audit.whatIsWrong: Level chart on disk (Karma / Skill / Singed / Singed / Karma / Singed / Singed) matched neither the packet chart nor the whys beside it, and contradicted the already-audited mirror.
audit.why: whys[1] says 'you chunk him for free every time he steps to CS', whys[2] says 'he still can't close the range gap', whys[3] calls 4-5 'your bullying peak' — all three sat on rows the chart gave to Singed.
audit.corrected: Chart set to Karma / Karma / Karma / Karma / Skill / Karma / Skill in both layers, matching the packet and the mirror's recorded chart exactly.

audit.whatIsWrong: Level 6 was written as 'no new ultimate' for Karma with no statement of what Singed actually gains.
audit.why: Mantra is live from level 1, so the only real spike at 6 is his: Insanity Potion, 100s cooldown, which makes Poison Trail apply Grievous Wounds.
audit.corrected: phases[4].why and spikes[2].text now name Insanity Potion, its 100s cooldown and the Grievous Wounds effect.

audit.whatIsWrong: Two real interactions absent: Insanity Potion's Grievous Wounds halving Karma's Mantra-W heal, and Fling rooting a target who lands in Mega Adhesive.
audit.why: Mantra-W self-heal is Karma's only sustain in this lane and it is the thing his ult turns off. And the E-into-W combo is his only hard lockdown — it is a root, not just a flip.
audit.corrected: Both written into breakdown.cooldowns; the anti-heal also into spikes[2].text and phases[4].why. Fling's 10s rank-1 cooldown and 125 range added.

audit.whatIsWrong: No cooldown numbers in the cooldown section.
audit.why: Fling at 125 range means he has to physically touch you — the concrete fact that makes the spacing advice actionable.
audit.corrected: Fling 10s / 125 range and Insanity Potion 100s now stated.

edits.before: W tether threatens the root — anyone who steps to you early eats Q-W and donates the trade.
edits.after: Fling is 125 range and he has no dash — every step he takes to CS costs him a free Inner Flame.

edits.before: Full kit: E shield-speed makes you untouchable in short trades. Mantra-Q (RQ) on cooldown gaps is a third of his HP.
edits.after: He still cannot close the range gap: layer Q into RQ and shove him off the wave before his sustain matters.

edits.before: No new ultimate at 6 — your Mantra has been online since level 1. His spike is the danger window: respect it.
edits.after: Insanity Potion (100s) makes Poison Trail apply Grievous Wounds, halving your Mantra-W heal — his one spike.

edits.before: Singed out-sustains and out-scales a chip war once he stacks HP and Liandry's, and your mana taps out first — you have no late spike, so the lead must already be banked.
edits.after: Singed out-sustains a chip war once he stacks HP and Liandry's, so the duel is his — but your shields and RE speed decide the fights he cannot solo, so it evens out.

edits.before: His one real threat — he flings you toward his tower or into his poison and runs you down with raw move speed; never step up with E (Inspire) on cooldown.
edits.after: Insanity Potion (100s) makes Poison Trail apply Grievous Wounds, halving your Mantra-W heal — and a Fling that lands you in Mega Adhesive roots you. Trade before he drinks.

edits.before: - Singed Fling: matchup-defining — The flip into his goo — never chase into range while it is up. It governs your forward steps. - E shield spent on poke is a death you scheduled. - Hold the R for the fight that decides something.
edits.after: - Singed Fling: 10s at rank 1 and only 125 range — he must touch you. Flung into Mega Adhesive you are rooted, so watch the goo first. - Insanity Potion is 100s and puts Grievous Wounds on Poison Trail: fight before he drinks.

notes: Level chart on disk disagreed with both the packet and the already-written whys on five of seven rows; it is now aligned with the mirror's chart in both layers. Row 6 is the one place I bent to the mirror: whys[6] read as a clean Singed scaling win, but the mirror and packet both say Skill, so I reworded the why rather than introduce a mirror conflict. Left diff EVEN / 5.5-10 alone despite a 72.73% win rate because that figure rests on only 11 packet games. The full layer still calls Karma 'he/him' throughout — a champion-level pass, not a per-matchup fix.
